subject.title: fix(nodes): keep Gateway connections healthy and consistent

question: Should the protected maintainer path accept this PR's password persistence and endpoint-retarget TLS behavior as the desired managed-node upgrade behavior?
rationale: The patch appears technically sound, but it changes credential materialization and TLS inheritance in a setup path, which repository policy treats as security- and upgrade-sensitive maintainer territory.

options.title: Accept Protected Path
options.body: Land this shape after removing the changelog edits and confirming exact-head CI/security review for the credential and TLS upgrade behavior.

options.title: Split Sensitive Pieces
options.body: Ask for the password/systemd credential work and TLS-retargeting behavior to land as separate smaller PRs if owners want narrower security review.

options.title: Pause TLS Policy
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want retargeted node installs to preserve TLS mode while clearing only stale fingerprints.
